fact: The World Bank's Global Findex 2025 report indicates that 50 percent of Malawian adults had a financial account in 2024, as reported by the Bankers Association of Malawi's chief executive.

The FinScope Consumer Survey Malawi 2023 findings report (FinMark Trust, 3,000 adults) says about two in every three adults (69%) currently use mobile money, up from 3% in 2014, and that 13% of adults are banked.
